title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_2006_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item (c) under (45) Romblon, paragraph f section two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven is amended to read as follows:
"(c) Gabawan-Odiongan High School Communal Irrigation System Completion ₱12,000.00"
Item (k) under (45) Romblon, paragraph f, section two of the same Act is repealed.

Project No. G-044.2, title G, appendix A of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"G-044.2: Gabawan-Odiongan High School Communal Irrigation System GR 90 15 15 75 8 Construction of diversion works; and canal; 300 hectares.

Project No. G-045.9, title G, appendix A of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"G-045.9: Concepcion Communal Irrigation System Badajoz : GR : 15 : : : : : : 15 : : : : 1 : Construction"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
